hero.description: A catalog of physics visualizations that embed into generated prose. What is listed here are contexts to mine questions from, not a list of visualizations to build. Only implemented ones carry a marker.

sections.catalog_description: Branches are scaffolding for browsing. Prose does not see branches — it picks from the whole topic list.

topic_detail.no_sim_body: This topic is listed as a context to mine questions from. A visualization is made when a question emerges here that prose cannot carry without a picture.
